messages:
Asha Patel: Quick run — we need a final pass on the website copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before launch. Priorities: launch post cadence, webinar landing + signups, inbound lead routing rules, and microcopy that reduces pre-sales questions. Who can take which part?
Miguel Torres: I can own launch posts and the social timeline. Also want to lock the hero messaging — leaning toward value props around predictable inference economics, not model access.
Samira Chen: I pushed a couple new hero options into the copy doc. Two contenders: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost" and "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." Need punchier subheads.
Jules Park: Updated mocks with shorter CTAs for each mode: "Try Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Deploy Private". Also adjusted hero padding so the secondary CTA fits above the fold.
Nina O'Connor: SEO check: avoid the phrase "LLM hosting" — recommend "LLM inference platform" and "inference API". Add canonical tag to /deployments and use "deployment options" as the H2.
Miguel Torres: Proposed launch timeline: week 1 blog + social blitz, week 2 deep-dive webinar (benchmarks), week 3 customer case study follow-up. Webinar landing must route signups to Sales vs Growth SDR based on intent signals. Rough routing rule below.
Samira Chen: Example routing pseudoconfig for the landing webhook:
```
// pseudo-rule for webinar signups
if signup.email.endsWith("@company.com") && signup.estimated_monthly_tokens > 10000:
  route = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
// also add utm_source and deployment_interest tags
```
Miguel Torres: Also want to tag leads with deployment interest: hosted|dedicated|private (pulled from the CTA they clicked). If they pick "Reserve Dedicated" mark as enterprise-interest.
Jules Park: Microcopy suggestions for the Dedicated card: "Dedicated = reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput. SLA-backed uptime and response targets. Contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Predictable performance at scale — ideal for production workloads."
Nina O'Connor: Lead schema we should standardize on the backend: lead_type: webinar|trial|enterprise, deployment_interest: hosted|dedicated|private, lead_source: social|blog|webinar. Must be included in the webhook payload so the CRM mapping is clean.
Samira Chen: For the post-signup email sequence: immediate thank-you with links (quickstart + runbook + webinar calendar), day-before reminder, and follow-up with benchmark highlights + CTA to request a dedicated trial. If sales-route, include SSO link for lead context.
Asha Patel: Nice. Last asks: 1) finalize hero and three short CTAs, 2) add the webhook pseudoconfig to the dev ticket, 3) draft the webinar narrative (benchmarks + migration playbook + live Q&A). Please add final copy suggestions by EOD Thursday so we can push staging copy on Friday. :rocket:
Miguel Torres: On it :thumbsup:
Samira Chen: I'll open PR for the copy + email templates and tag you all.
deploy-bot: New deploy to staging scheduled for Fri 16:00 UTC — will include marketing pages if PR merged.
Asha Patel: Ping me if blocked, otherwise we'll ship the draft and iterate from analytics after the webinar.
